title: I Almost Paid ₹1,499 for Prime Video I Never Use. An Open-Source AI Model Caught It.
why_read: A personal anecdote about catching an unwanted subscription charge using an open-source AI model, more consumer story than deep technical content.
analysis: This article frames a personal billing surprise (an auto-renewed Prime subscription) as a hook for a Hacktoberfest challenge submission involving an open-source AI model. The narrative about subscription business models is mildly interesting but not technical in nature. Details about which open-source AI model was used and how it actually caught the charge are not clear from the excerpt. It reads more like a blog-style personal essay than an engineering writeup.
